start-page.caption: Start page: tutorial, new project, open, import, sample cards and recent files

overview-plan.caption: Floor plan: menus, tabs and toolbar, furniture library on the left, drawing in the middle, properties on the right, status bar below

overview-3d.caption: 3D view: scenes, levels, display, section and sun on the left, the picked element on the right

walls-chain.caption: Wall tool (W): each click continues the chain, the length and angle are shown

walls-typed-length.caption: Typed length: type a number while drawing for an exact length (4500, 3.6m, 3600<90)

walls-joints.caption: Wall joints: corners mitre automatically, T and cross joints are drawn cleanly

walls-inspector.caption: Select a wall to edit its thickness, height, wall type, materials and phase on the right

rooms.caption: Rooms (A): click inside walls for a room with its name and area

doors-windows.caption: Doors (D) and windows (N): click on a wall; X flips the swing, H swaps the hinge

furniture-library.caption: Furniture library: filter or search, then drag onto the plan or click to place

furniture-picker.caption: F: find furniture by name and place it

stairs-columns.caption: Stairs (S) and columns (C): stairs from two points, a column with one click

roof-plan.caption: Roofs (O): gable, hip, shed or flat over the top level

roof-3d.caption: Roofs and storeys appear in 3D straight away

levels.caption: Level tabs: pick a storey (+ adds one); the level below shows faintly

dimensions-text.caption: Dimensions (K), text (T), lines (L) and measure (M); auto dimensions measure the outside walls at once

grids.caption: Structural grids (G): grid lines with A, B, C … and 1, 2, 3 … bubbles

select-box.caption: Box select: Shift+drag (left to right = fully inside, right to left = crossing)

context-menu.caption: Right-click menu: Undo / Redo at the top, then commands for the element

properties-dialog.caption: Double-click (or E): every property of an element in one window

undo-history.caption: Undo history: go back to any earlier step

command-palette.caption: Command palette (Ctrl+K): search every command, room, level and furniture

massing-plan.caption: Masses (B box, U cylinder, polygon): draw in plan, set height and taper

pushpull.caption: Push/Pull: drag the top of a mass or wall up or down

paint-bucket.caption: Paint bucket: pick a material on the left and click walls, floors, roofs or masses

tape-measure.caption: Tape measure: the distance between two points on the model

scenes.caption: Scenes: save the current view (+), click to fly there, ▶ plays them in turn

section-cut.caption: Section (X): cuts the current level 1.2 m above the floor

walk-mode.caption: Walk (V): walk around at eye height with W/A/S/D

sun-study.caption: Sun study: real shadows from the site, date and time

grid-3d.caption: 3D grid: a slightly stronger line every 5 cells (5×5) like the plan, the same spacing at any zoom

context-menu-3d.caption: 3D right-click menu: Undo / Redo, views and tools

bim-renovation.caption: Phases: existing (grey), demolished (red dashed) and new walls; compare with View → Phases

bim-inspector.caption: BIM data: phase, classification, IFC class, GlobalId and custom properties

wall-types.caption: Wall types: layers (structure, insulation, finish) define the thickness

bim-properties.caption: BIM properties: add properties such as a fire rating to the selection

schedules.caption: Schedules: rooms, doors & windows, wall types, costs and levels — export as CSV

schedules-cost.caption: Cost tab: a rough estimate from unit prices × quantities

model-check.caption: Model check (F5): overlapping walls, blocked doors, clashes … click an issue to go there

project-properties.caption: Project properties: title, address, site latitude / longitude, time zone and classification system

formats.caption: Supported formats for opening, import and export

import-picker.caption: Import: DXF, SVG, IFC, 3D models and images

cad-tracing.caption: Tracing a DXF: imported CAD layers shown under the walls you draw

cad-layers.caption: CAD layers: visibility, colour and lock per layer

export-3d.caption: 3D export: GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL, DAE, 3MF, USDZ or PLY with units

print-preview.caption: Print window: printer, paper, margins, scale and contents on the left, a preview of the real sheets on the right; Print prints at once

recent-files.caption: Recent files: up to 10, remove one or clear the list

settings.caption: Settings (Ctrl+,): tabs for general, plan, walls, 3D, output …; numbers use − / +

themes.caption: Themes: 40 dark and light themes plus your own

light-theme.caption: The plan in a light theme

panels-collapsed.caption: Collapsed panels (Ctrl+1 / Ctrl+2) stay as an icon and title

status-bar.caption: Status bar: position, level, grid, snap, ortho, scale, units, selection and check; the grip resizes the window

tutorial-watch.caption: Tutorial, watch mode: the program performs each step

tutorial-practice.caption: Tutorial, practice mode: the place to act is marked and your result is checked

shortcuts.caption: Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+/ or Help → Keyboard shortcuts)
